Post#cook explicitly returns `raw` unmodified for raw_html posts (`return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`), and the view renders `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. So entity-encoded HTML (<script>, onerror=, javascript:) in feed content is decoded then stored/rendered without any sanitization pipeline — the described XSS mechanism is verifiable from the diff alone.

adjudication.rationale: In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, the code does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and then calls `TopicEmbed.import(..., content)`. `TopicEmbed.import` creates a post with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly for `:raw_html` (skipping the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline). That means any entity-escaped markup in the feed (e.g. `<script>`, `<img onerror=...>`, `javascript:` URLs) becomes real HTML via `unescapeHTML` and is then stored/served as raw HTML without sanitization. `absolutize_urls` only rewrites relative `href/src` and does not remove dangerous attributes/protocols. This is a verifiable XSS/security defect introduced by the diff.
